# dsh-pet animation assets

Source: https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet

These selected transparent WebM animations and the character image are copied from
dsh-pet for the floating AI assistant in this project:

- `idle.webm` ← 待机呼吸休闲.webm
- `look.webm` ← 东张西望.webm
- `think.webm` ← 工作状态-思考冒泡.webm
- `cheer.webm` ← 工作状态-雀跃庆祝.webm
- `happy.webm` ← 点击回应-开心跃动.webm
- `sleep-start.webm` ← 睡觉-开始.webm
- `sleep-loop.webm` ← 睡觉-循环.webm
- `sleep-wake.webm` ← 睡觉-起来.webm
- `surprised.webm` ← 被吓一跳.webm
- `stretch.webm` ← 超大伸懒腰.webm
- `character.png` ← assets/main-character.png
- `character-transparent.png` — generated from the first frame of `idle.webm` for the poster/fallback

This project uses only the animation assets for an assistant character; it does not
include the dsh-pet DSH/Cordis plugin runtime.
